result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password** as the best overall password manager.

The most important thing is to choose a business password manager rather than simply sharing a personal password vault. You want shared team vaults, individual accounts, access controls, secure offboarding and an audit trail.

Here are the options I'd shortlist.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent, intuitive interface.
- Shared vaults for teams and departments.
- Granular permissions and admin controls.
- Security alerts and password health monitoring.
- Good integrations with business tools.

**Price\:** Teams Starter Pack \$24.95/month for up to 10 users, billed annually.

Ideal for teams that value ease of use and security.

[1Password business pricing](https://1password.com/pricing/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source software.
- Shared collections and team vaults.
- Audit and event logs.
- Directory synchronisation and SCIM.
- Option for self-hosting.

**Price\:** \$4/user/month for Teams, billed annually.

Ideal for technically minded teams wanting strong security without spending much.

[Bitwarden business pricing](https://bitwarden.com/en-gb/pricing/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and role-based access.
- Security auditing and reporting.
- Additional enterprise security features.

**Price\:** Varies by business plan.

Ideal for businesses with more demanding security or compliance requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Shared vaults.
- End-to-end encryption.
- Useful email alias functionality.

Ideal for privacy-conscious smaller businesses.

[Proton Pass for business](https://proton.me/pass/business)

## Quick comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden | Keeper |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Good | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good | Excellent |
| Audit logs | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Self-hosting | No | Yes\* | No |
| Value for money | Good | Excellent | Good |


\*Bitwarden self-hosting is an Enterprise deployment option. Prices above are indicative USD prices, excluding taxes; check current UK pricing before purchasing. [1password.com](https://1password.com/pricing/business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/en-gb/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.openideurope.eu](https://www.openideurope.eu/reviews/password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to **1Password and Bitwarden**\.

- Choose 1Password if you want something staff can adopt easily with minimal training.
- Choose Bitwarden if you want to keep costs down while maintaining good team security features.
